interface.longDescription: Use Chiho Telegram to connect Codex to Telegram CRM workflows through Chiho.ai Cloud or a self-hosted tgchats MCP runtime. The plugin packages mode-selection guidance, workflow skills, and local MCP configuration for inbox triage, search, folders, tags, companies, tasks, summaries, rules, sync, exports, approved sends, invites, and group cleanup.
